method: Vite source fixture imports the public src/ui/index.ts entry and renders real SFCs and examples; headless Chromium runtime.

checks.name: public entry, native attrs/theme/tag, default provider, and UItem slot scope
checks.details: The real SFC root kept attrs/style/theme/tag and the default provider; selected IDs and public selected values are distinct, and all UItem slot fields were rendered.

checks.name: legacy/default and renderless UItem, id-based API, legacy value API, and group:selected payload
checks.details: Default button and tag=false slots worked; isSelected/select use IDs while toggle/isValueSelected retain their value contract, and group:selected carried { value }.

checks.name: implicit index, explicit null, object comparator, and single array-valued item
checks.details: Distinct value shapes selected their matching item without treating a single array model as a multiple-selection array.

checks.name: mandatory boolean and force behavior with disabled/readonly guards
checks.details: Boolean mandatory blocks deselection without initializing; force chooses the first enabled entry only when the group is interactive.

checks.name: max, dynamic item/group disabled, and readonly guards
checks.details: Selection respected max and live item/group disabled/readonly state without conflating readonly with the native disabled attribute.

checks.name: next/previous empty, cyclic, disabled skipping, and multiple model behavior
checks.details: Public exposed navigation skipped disabled entries, wrapped, initialized empty selection, and reduced multiple selection to the target item.

checks.name: keyed reorder, stable identity, omitted-index recalculation, and navigation order
checks.details: Reversing keyed children did not remount them; state order, fallback indices, selection and navigation followed rendered order and removal.

checks.name: UBtnToggle and UChipGroup integration
checks.details: Button and chip registrations preserved index/explicit values, max, disabled state, selected classes, and their public v-model arrays.

checks.name: UItemGroup form validation and reset integration
checks.details: The group rejected invalid input, validated after selection, and restored its setup-time model through both group and form reset APIs.

checks.name: real item/item-group/chip demos
checks.details: The shipped examples were clicked through model changes, max, navigation, disabled/readonly guards, and chip selection.

demoInteractions: real UItem default/renderless controls and group:selected counter; UItemGroup multi/max/navigation/disabled/readonly controls; UChipGroup selection
limits: No Electron renderer, full project build, full test suite, or visual design acceptance was run.
The fixture validates local source through the public entry; it does not validate the compiled package bundle.
backendLimit: Chromium browser renderer only; no Electron renderer acceptance is claimed.
